description: Look up a small business's SBA 7(a) or 504 loan(s) by borrower name. Returns individual loan records: amounts, lender, approval date, status (P I F / PIF = paid in full, CHGOFF = charged off, CANCLD = cancelled, EXEMPT), and — for charged-off loans — the charge-off amount. Street addresses are never stored or returned (city/state/ZIP only). Scope to a state to disambiguate common business names.

borrower_name.description: Business or sole-proprietor name to search (substring match), e.g. "Ameripro Construction".

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504". Omit to search both.

state.description: Two-letter state code to scope the search, e.g. "PA".

name: sba_loan_lookup
title: Sba Loan Lookup
